title: FAMU vs MorganState: tuition, size, location
summary: Florida Agricultural and Mechanical University (FAMU) versus Morgan State University (MorganState). Also searched as MorganState vs FAMU. Scorecard table is sourced; prose is checked against those facts. UniRepository is not affiliated with either school.

sections.heading: How they differ
paragraphs: Morgan State University and Florida Agricultural and Mechanical University (MorganState vs FAMU) are both public institutions, yet they differ in several key aspects. Morgan State University, located in Baltimore, has a larger undergraduate enrollment of 9,019 students compared to FAMU's 7,582 students in Tallahassee. Additionally, the in-state tuition at Morgan State is $8,229, which is higher than FAMU's in-state tuition of $5,785. These differences highlight variations in size, cost, and geographic location between MorganState vs FAMU.

sections.heading: Cost
paragraphs: When comparing the cost of attendance between Morgan State University and Florida Agricultural and Mechanical University (MorganState vs FAMU), notable differences emerge. Morgan State's in-state tuition is $8,229, which exceeds FAMU's in-state tuition of $5,785. For out-of-state students, Morgan State charges $19,124, slightly higher than FAMU's $17,725. Regarding student debt, the median debt for completers at Morgan State is $27,250, whereas FAMU's median debt is $23,548. These figures illustrate the financial considerations prospective students may weigh when evaluating MorganState vs FAMU.

sections.heading: Learning model and campus
paragraphs: Morgan State University and Florida Agricultural and Mechanical University (MorganState vs FAMU) both offer traditional campus-based learning models in urban settings. Morgan State University is situated in Baltimore, Maryland, and serves a larger undergraduate population of 9,019 students. In contrast, Florida Agricultural and Mechanical University is located in Tallahassee, Florida, with an undergraduate enrollment of 7,582 students. These differences in campus location and student body size contribute to distinct campus experiences at MorganState vs FAMU.
